title: Ledger appends fail loudly at the 8 s lock deadline under heavy multi-process contention (13 procs: ~5% of appends; 5 procs x 20: ~1 in 260 in checker run)
evidence: Maker replay (manifest iss-alloc-005): 13 procs x 20 appends, deadline timeouts 42/780 after the ALLOC-005 fix (67 before); 4-way 4/320. Checker (alloc005 checker, temp ledger): 13 procs x 20 appends x 5 runs gave 0,1,0,1,0 timeouts; every returned id unique and every acknowledged row present exactly once, no spurious EPERM. Failure is a clean LedgerError (no row written, no corruption), caller can retry. Cause is a fixed 10-35 ms random sleep poll with no fairness, plus CPU starvation of the lock holder on a loaded box.
fix_direction: Optional: raise default LEDGER_LOCK_WAIT_MS or have the CLI retry once on the deadline error; not worth a unit alone. Class: availability, not security, not data integrity.
